text: opus5-11 up on 4183. Taking the eraser (!p1) and pen revamp (!p2) cards together since they share the brush-size model.

Design settled. Eraser clips a stroke node polyline against the eraser disc analytically (quadratic, not sampled) and rewrites the survivors as new stroke nodes, so a cut mid-line leaves two nodes with a real gap. Whole sweep is one batch undo entry. Toolbar button is injected from JS rather than added to markup: the same toolbar pill is copy-pasted into 7 HTML files and no build may run. 21 anchored hunks, all unique, patched copy parses. board-shift-snap-runtime still 12/12 against the patched file.

Done. Eraser + pen brush size: 21 anchored hunks in .tmp/scratch/opus5-11/patch.json, all anchors verified unique against the file on disk. Proved in a real page against a patched mirror: rubbing a hole in a 60-point squiggle leaves two nodes with a real gap, one Ctrl+Z restores it whole, one Ctrl+Shift+Z re-cuts it. Alt+scroll resizes the brush with the camera provably unmoved, plain scroll still zooms. Long-pressing the pen icon shows a true-scale size circle that follows the pointer. tests/board/pen-and-eraser-tools.test.mjs 5/5 with the patch, fails without it. Green against the patch: shift-snap runtime 12/12, shift-snap e2e 5/5, alt-drag-copy-undo 5/5, alt-key-menu-suppression, overlay-wheel-scroll, markdown-wheel-zoom, markdown-wheel-routing. Whole board folder 65 pass 3 fail, and all 3 fail identically on the unpatched repo (two are other agents unapplied suites, one is a port 4185 collision). Trap for the next mirror: preview-server resolves its root from import.meta.url, so scripts/ must be a real copy, not a junction, or it silently serves the unpatched file.
